newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Komax sets Swiss public offering price.
newsitem.headline: Komax sets Swiss public offering price.

text.p: Komax AG, a producer of wire processing systems, said it set the price on its initial public offering of 142,000 registered shares at 435 Swiss francs per share.
The subscription period for the shares is June 4 to June 9 and the stock will be listed on the Swiss Exchange on June 11. The closing date for the initial offering is June 16, Komax also said.
Swiss Bank Corp will manage the underwriting.

Komax had 1996 turnover of 120.2 million Swiss francs and a profit of 32.1 million. It has forecast turnover of 125 million for 1997 and 136 million for 1998. Operating profit was forecast as 14.5 million and 16.5 million, respectively.
After going public, 41 percent of the company's shares will be publicly held.
